correctness.rationale: Exact classification of dual admissible faces and matching by nonzero-edge fibers proves a contractible core with one critical vertex. Every additional four-vertex support adds a full five-simplex along an octahedral two-sphere; pairwise overlaps lie in the core. The CW cofiber decomposition proves the infinite-family dual wedge; integral Alexander duality gives torsion-free homology in the stated degree. The delivered checker exhaustively reconstructs the dual and an acyclic matching for n=5 through 8. No finite test is treated as an all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Determines a full integral homology classification, all-parameter torsion-freeness and nonshellability for a natural infinite family of canonical triangular graphs. A precise homotopy decomposition of the Alexander dual is itself a motivated structural theorem, with an explicit combinatorial explanation for binomial(n-1,4) sphere multiplicity; it is neither a small numerical gain nor an arbitrary finite slice.
